what: Study 83, for the critique's request to group sources by the organisation behind them. Rule: a source joins an organisation when it stands on that organisation's own address, or when study 81 coded its runner as the maker and the models it tests are that maker's own, or when study 81's runner notes name it the same evaluation organisation as another source. Every other source counts as its own unit: authors' affiliations were not coded, so this grouping can only merge what the record already names, and the true number of independent organisations may be smaller.
